title: erodium cicutarium subsp. salzmannii
intro: Erodium cicutarium subsp. salzmannii, commonly known as redstem filaree, is a plant species within the Geranium family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, particularly its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of redstem filaree are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and protect against oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
